name: AUTH_016 - 4th wrong OTP should show 1 attempt remaining
fullName: AUTH_016 - 4th wrong OTP should show 1 attempt remaining

steps.name: request ("{ method: 'POST', url: 'https://dl-api.finj.in/api/v1/auth/valid'... 7 more characters, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: { mobileNumber: '7982330415', otp: '514032' }, failOnStatusCode: false, timeout: 30000 }")
assert expected **400** to be one of **[ 400, 401 ]**
assert expected **{ Object (status, errorCode, ...) }** to have property **status**

parameters.name: actual

steps.name: assert expected **{ Object (status, errorCode, ...) }** to have property **status** of **FAILED**
assert expected **{ Object (status, errorCode, ...) }** to have property **errorCode**

parameters.name: actual

steps.name: assert Expected errorCode to be one of: ERR_1005 | ERR_1006: expected **true** to be true
assert expected **{ Object (status, errorCode, ...) }** to have property **message**

parameters.name: actual

steps.name: assert Expected message to include "Incorrect OTP. 1 attempts remaining.": expected **Incorrect OTP. 1 attempts remaining.** to include **Incorrect OTP. 1 attempts remaining.**
assert expected **[ 400, 401 ]** to be an array

labels.value: Auth API > Validate OTP - Wrong OTP Attempt Lifecycle
